meta.githubCommitMessage:
Save the chat history in Supabase

The history moves from localStorage to a chat_sessions table in Supabase,
with row-level security per visitor. The browser signs in anonymously
with the first saved chat; /api/history reads and writes through
@supabase/ssr with tracePropagation, so Supabase's API gateway logs
carry the trace ID of the Next.js request.

Assisted-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Supabase option: add trace context to SQL statements

Turns on the Java agent's sqlcommenter, so statements in Supabase's
Postgres logs carry the traceparent of the request that ran them.

meta.githubCommitMessage:
Add an option to run PetClinic's database on Supabase

compose.supabase.yaml points PetClinic at a Supabase Postgres through the
pooler (session mode) instead of the local container, and adds a Collector
config that scrapes Supabase's Metrics API once a minute. The default
setup is unchanged.
